description: Fuzz web targets with ffuf for content, parameter, and vhost discovery — FUZZ keyword placement in paths, query strings, POST bodies and Host headers, matcher/filter calibration (-mc/-fs/-ac), recursion, and when to switch to feroxbuster/gobuster/dirsearch. Load when a web target needs hidden paths, files, parameters, or virtual hosts enumerated. Signals: ffuf -w FUZZ, directory brute force, gobuster dir, feroxbuster, dirsearch, raft-medium-directories, burp-parameter-names, 404 filtering.
